value.name: EMIG: Stop the Bleed WR
value.description:
Join us at the West Reading Campus for a Stop the Bleed Training! The Tower Health Emergency Medicine Residents will hold the training

What is stop the bleed?
Stop the Bleed is a national initiative and training program that empowers civilians to act as immediate responders, learning to control life-threatening bleeding from traumatic injuries before professionals arrive. It focuses on three key techniques—direct pressure, wound packing, and tourniquet application—to prevent death from hemorrhage, which can occur within five minutes.

Stop by and design meaningful, handmade keepsakes at a variety of craft stations, including embossed leather goods, perler bead magnets, shrinky dink keychains for a nostalgic throwback, DIY button and ribbon headbands, and custom photo frames. All supplies are provided, and no crafting experience is needed—just bring your imagination. Take a break from the end-of-semester stress and enjoy a relaxed, welcoming space to create something personal and heartfelt. Come with friends or craft solo, and leave with a gift that’s thoughtful, unique, and made by you.

value.name: Getting Started in Medical Student Research: Library Resources & Research Basics
value.description:
These two sessions, led by Sarah Hughes, Health Sciences Librarian with Drexel University Libraries, will introduce medical students to library resources and foundational research skills. Topics will include getting started with research, developing a research question, understanding different types of projects such as literature reviews, scoping reviews, and systematic reviews, choosing appropriate databases, building a search strategy, and using concepts such as MeSH terms, PICO, and PRISMA.

The sessions will also include time for questions and discussion. This event is especially intended for students interested in beginning or strengthening research projects over the summer, but all DUCOM students are welcome to attend.

We will be studying various books of the Bible and topics/themes throughout the year.  Anyone is welcome no matter how familiar you are with the Bible, and you can join any week of the year - no preparation required! DM our Instagram @drexelcru for more information!
